# Referral Program Email Template

## Subject Line: 
Share FLS With Friends, Earn Exclusive Rewards

## Preview Text:
Refer a friend to FLS and both of you will receive special benefits

---

![FLS Referral Program]

# GREAT PRODUCTS ARE MEANT TO BE SHARED

## INTRODUCE YOUR FRIENDS TO FLS

You'll both receive rewards when they make their first purchase.

---

**Dear [Customer Name],**

Your satisfaction with FLS means the world to us, and we believe the best compliments come through recommendations to friends and family. That's why we've created a referral program that rewards both you and the people you introduce to our premium lighters.

### HOW IT WORKS:

**1. Share Your Unique Link**
Use your personal referral link below to share FLS with friends who appreciate quality and performance.

**Your Referral Link:** [https://flsusa.shop/refer/[CustomerID]]

[SHARE VIA EMAIL] [SHARE VIA TEXT] [SHARE VIA SOCIAL]

**2. Friends Receive a Special Offer**
When your friends click your link, they'll receive **15% off** their first FLS purchase – introducing them to the reliability and craftsmanship that you already enjoy.

**3. You Earn Rewards**
For each friend who makes a purchase using your link, you'll receive:

- **$20 Credit** toward your next FLS purchase
- **500 Elite Points** added to your loyalty account
- **Early Access** to our next limited edition release

### WHY YOUR FRIENDS WILL THANK YOU:

- **Unmatched Reliability** with our wind-resistant technology
- **Ergonomic Comfort** from our signature curved base design
- **Premium Construction** that stands the test of time
- **Sleek Aesthetics** that make a statement

### TOP REFERRERS THIS MONTH:

1. Michael T. – 8 referrals
2. Jessica L. – 6 referrals
3. David R. – 5 referrals

Will you join our leaderboard? The top three referrers each month receive an exclusive FLS limited edition lighter not available for purchase.

[START REFERRING NOW]

Thank you for being a valued part of the FLS community and for sharing our commitment to quality with others who appreciate the difference.

Spark connections,

**The FLS Team**
